div.head: Wer Inscr.
div.ab: Hu man sceal gyldan twelfhyndes man.
(Wie jemand von 1200 [Schilling Wergeld, wenn erschlagen,] entgolten werden muss. B)
(How one must pay for a man of 1200 [shillings' wergild, when slain]. B)
div.note: Liebermann's text has two columns: H (Textus Roffensis f. 41v, after EGu in the same line and hand, c. 1120; perhaps a fragment of a law) and B (Cambridge, Corpus Christi College 383, p. 86, after Wif, as in the Quadripartitus, c. 1125). K is B; H is also given here. B's heading is in red and not original; H has none. Liebermann dates Wer 944–c. 1060.
